Vovkovyntsi Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Jewish life in Vovkovyntsi is documented from 1737, and the community grew to a majority of the town's population — 56 percent — by 1897, with local Jews engaged in crafts and owning three mills. This cemetery itself became an execution site: 396 Jews were killed here between 1941 and 1943, while another 280 residents were deported to Derazhnya and murdered there in September 1942. The cemetery was later destroyed during the Soviet era, leaving no visible trace today.
